page.overview:
Who is Mold Devil?

The |Kabi no Akuma}} is the devil who embodies the concept of mold.

The Mold Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Mold Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point Kato and Tanabe made a contract with the Mold Devil.
